_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Sing aloud; do not fear.
The Lord our God is in our midst.
Shout for joy; the Lord has taken away the judgment against you.
The Lord our God is in our midst.
Rejoice in the Lord always; again I say, rejoice.
Come, let us worship with joy. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Can you hear it? Under the gray of these short days, a song is starting up.
Joy is welling up like water.
The Lord has turned away your shame and gathered the ones who grieved.
Joy is welling up like water.
With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
Joy is welling up like water.
So do not be anxious; the Lord is near, and near is no small thing.
Joy is welling up like water. Rejoice!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Sing aloud; the Lord is in your midst.
Joy is welling up like water.
Draw water from the wells of salvation.
Joy is welling up like water.
The Lord is near; rejoice, and again rejoice.
Joy is welling up like water. Amen.
